title: Just Maple
body:
As Minecraft is adding the Dappled Forest and Poplar wood type in version 26.3, this mod will no longer recieve updates past 26.2 as it is redundant.

## About Just Maple introduces maple wood to minecraft with a whole new maple grove biome, new trees, blocks and an entirely new wood variant! ## Features - Check out the Maple Grove biome - found in mountainous areas! - Craft new maple wood building blocks - Admire the new maple trees, with falling leaf particles and fallen maple leaf litter ## Compatibility **See supported versions in Versions (Modrinth) or Files (Curseforge) above!** ### Dependencies - Requires Fabric API - Requires Terrablender ## Installation Use Modrinth App or Curseforge! *OR* 1. Install Fabric Loader for any supported version 2. Download dependencies ^ 3. Download mod from Modrinth or CurseForge websites 4. Place the API and mod file into your mods folder 5. Launch the game using the Fabric profile ## Credits - Made by CaptainDude - Thanks to Quadrillage for the textures ## FAQ **Q: Where can I find the maple grove biome?** A: It is about as common as the cherry grove. Look in mountainous areas, or use `/locate` to find one. **Q: How do I make the new maple wood blocks?** A: Craft them the same way you would any other wood variant.
